# Reduced data products in the ESO Phase 3 archive (Status: 02 June 2020)

The ESO Phase 3 archive provides access to reduced and calibrated data products. All these data are stored in standard formats and can be queried via unified web query interfaces. These web interfaces are:

* the ESO Science Portal (http://archive.eso.org/scienceportal ). A graphical web user interface that offers access to ESO Phase3 and ALMA data jointly.
* the standard ESO query interface (http://archive.eso.org/wdb/wdb/adp/phase3_main/form ).
* and programmatically via VO interfaces (TAP/ObsCore, DataLin
